attribution.title: British Museum Asia 14
attribution.author: Gryffindor
attribution.description: Drum slab. Limestone, 3rd century CE. This slab was first carved in about the 1st century BCE. When the Great Stupa was refurbished under the patronage of the Satavahana rulers beginning in about the 2nd century CE, the slab was turned over and carved on this side with a Buddha figure within the stupa. Side B: The Great Stupa at Amaravati with the Buddha standing in human form in the entrance to the monument. OA 1880.7-9.79.
